run_pairwise_hamming_distance: run pairwise Hamming distance computation on an integer-encoded sequence array
test_num_clusters: test the num_clusters function with a square pairwise distance matrix and distance threshold

review_metrics: review the metrics module for computing clustering counts and Hamming distances on sequence data
